data.one_liner: Pick directories and list file system entries across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing native system dialogs for directory picking and file system entry listing. It supports streaming large directory trees and persisting access across app restarts via platform-specific features like bookmarks and URI permissions.
use_when: You need users to pick directories using native system dialogs across desktop, mobile, and web.
You need to list or stream contents of picked directories recursively.
You need to maintain access to folders across app restarts using bookmarks or URI permissions.
avoid_when: You only need to pick individual files rather than directories.
Your target browser environment is Firefox or Safari on the web, which lack directory picker support.
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
Supports directory listing and stream-based entry reading for large folders.
Persistent access handling for picked folders across app restarts.
weaknesses: Web platform support is restricted to Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge) supporting the File System Access API.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding security-scoped bookmark entitlements to macOS Release and DebugProfile entitlements.
